items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: One of those rock and roll groups did record "Stormy Monday" and he and Billy Eckstine got a hell of a lot of money for that.

ctx.x: But then if you look at them like, for the six months ended now, six months from now, and -- I mean, those figures jump about so much and I can't see what the reason for it is, because suddenly -- well, I know one thing, though. One of those rock and roll groups did record "Stormy Monday" and he and Billy Eckstine got a hell of a lot of money for that.
